I based my initial choice on what supported my crappalicious dell keyboard out of the box, and that was several debian cds. GNOME is somewhat monolithic and this turns a lot of people off. Developers make decisions for you, stylistic decisions, default programs, etc. Functionally, it's heavier on your cpu/gpu than kde, openbox, etc and a fair chunk of linux users have love for deprecated hardware.
